website.title: Stripe | Financial Infrastructure to Grow Your Revenue
website.meta_description: Stripe is a financial services platform that helps all types of businesses accept payments, build flexible billing models and manage money movement.

brand.business_overview: Stripe is a financial services platform that provides comprehensive tools and infrastructure for businesses of all sizes to accept payments, build flexible billing models, manage money movement, prevent fraud, and offer financial services globally. It aims to help businesses grow their revenue by providing reliable and scalable financial technology.

competitor_analysis.business_overview: Stripe provides a comprehensive suite of financial infrastructure tools, enabling businesses to accept payments, manage billing, prevent fraud, issue cards, and facilitate global money movement. It caters to both startups and large enterprises, focusing on scalability, developer-friendliness, and revenue growth.
products_and_services: Accept and optimise payments globally – online and in person
Access borderless money movement with stablecoins and crypto

competitors.name: PayPal / Braintree
strengths: Strong brand recognition and trust among consumers
Extensive global reach and user base
Braintree offers robust developer tools and customizable payment solutions
weaknesses: Perceived higher transaction fees for some merchants
Less emphasis on comprehensive financial infrastructure beyond payments
Braintree's developer experience might be less streamlined than Stripe's for some use cases

competitors.name: Adyen
strengths: Strong focus on enterprise-level clients and global commerce
Unified commerce platform for online, mobile, and in-store payments
Advanced risk management and data analytics capabilities
weaknesses: May be less accessible or cost-effective for smaller businesses and startups
Developer documentation and community support might be less extensive than Stripe's
Less emphasis on broader financial services like card issuing or crypto payments compared to Stripe's expanding suite

competitors.name: Square / Block
strengths: Strong presence in SMB market, especially for in-person payments and POS systems
Offers a broader ecosystem of business tools (payroll, banking, loans)
weaknesses: Historically more focused on SMBs, less on large enterprises and complex integrations
Global reach and multi-currency support might be less comprehensive than Stripe's for certain markets
Developer tools for highly customized financial infrastructure might be less mature than Stripe's

competitive_advantages: Comprehensive financial infrastructure covering payments, billing, fraud, card issuing, and crypto.
Highly developer-friendly APIs, SDKs, and documentation for flexible integrations.
Strong focus on scalability and reliability, handling high transaction volumes with high uptime.
Solutions tailored for both startups and large enterprises, demonstrated by diverse customer examples.
Proactive innovation in areas like stablecoins, AI-powered support, and agentic commerce.
positioning_opportunities: Emphasize the 'financial infrastructure' aspect as a complete operating system for modern businesses, not just a payment processor.
Highlight the unique capabilities in emerging areas like stablecoin payments and AI integration for future-proofing businesses.
Showcase the seamless transition and scalability for businesses from startup phase to enterprise level.
Position as the go-to platform for global expansion, simplifying complex international payment and regulatory challenges.
Focus on the 'grow your revenue' promise by detailing how each service directly contributes to business expansion and efficiency.
competitor_analysis.verification_note: Competitors are AI-inferred based on the business category and offerings, as no direct competitors were cited on the website.

recommended_faqs.question: What is Stripe and what services does it offer?
recommended_faqs.recommended_answer: Stripe is a financial services platform that provides tools for businesses to accept payments, manage billing, prevent fraud, issue cards, and facilitate global money movement, acting as a comprehensive financial infrastructure.

recommended_faqs.question: How does Stripe help businesses grow their revenue?
recommended_faqs.recommended_answer: Stripe helps businesses grow revenue by offering flexible payment acceptance, advanced billing models, robust fraud prevention, global expansion capabilities, and tools to build new financial services, all designed to scale with business needs.

recommended_faqs.question: Is Stripe suitable for both small businesses and large enterprises?
recommended_faqs.recommended_answer: Yes, Stripe provides flexible and scalable solutions tailored for businesses of all sizes, from startups building their foundation to large enterprises like Hertz and Instacart managing billions in revenue.

recommended_faqs.question: Can I accept international payments with Stripe?
recommended_faqs.recommended_answer: Absolutely. Stripe enables businesses to accept and optimize payments globally, supporting a wide range of currencies and payment methods for online and in-person transactions.

recommended_faqs.question: What kind of support and integration options does Stripe provide?
recommended_faqs.recommended_answer: Stripe offers professional services, certified experts, tiered support plans, comprehensive APIs, SDKs, and no-code tools, allowing businesses to build custom integrations or use pre-integrated platforms.
